method_selection.why: Validation peaks at epoch 8 and declines through epoch 10 while training loss continues downward, indicating mild overfit plus seed-level variance. This is the only available non-dead card: first reproduce the baseline across paired seeds, then use a small 3-seed rank ensemble to quantify and reduce variance at lower cost than the prior 5-seed run. Expected gain is honestly only about +0.0004 to +0.001, below epsilon, so this is primarily a variance-validation step rather than a claimed convergence-resetting improvement.

rejected.reason: Best direct treatment for the observed overfit, but its running-elsewhere status makes it unavailable.
Running elsewhere and unavailable; moreover, its hard 18-second routing conflicts with the journal directive to validate duration inputs softly before separate heads.
Running elsewhere and unavailable; campaign memory also marks SWA/EMA as measured dead on this benchmark.

expected_delta_basis: The selector diagnosis estimates +0.0004 to +0.001 for a three-seed ensemble, while run_unseeded_19 measured +0.00139 from five seeds with diminishing returns.

hypothesis: An aggressive FM regularization package combining 0.3 embedding-interaction dropout, accessed-row embedding L2, AdamW weight decay, and 0.5-per-epoch learning-rate decay will delay overfitting and improve the paired three-seed ensemble validation primary by at least 0.002 versus the parent FM ensemble.
